versions.changelog:
agent-memory-system v1.0.1

- Added install.sh and scripts/install.sh for streamlined installation.
- Updated documentation in README.md.
- Updated metadata in _meta.json for improved clarity and consistency.

agent-memory-system v1.0.0

- Initial release of the long-term memory system for OpenClaw Agent.
- Features temperature-based memory management (hot/warm/cold) with automatic archiving of data older than 30 days.
- Includes nightly reflection with health monitoring and periodic memory cleanup.
- Enables extraction of reusable skills from lessons learned.
- Provides directory templates and scripts for installation, cron automation, and troubleshooting.
